limitations: Paper full text and supplementary tables unavailable (publisher HTTP 403, not in PMC, no repository copy); only the PubMed abstract and MeSH headings were read.

SILAC channel map (heavy = nicotinamide, light = control) comes from the submitter's List_of_RAW_files.xlsx, which also notes the SILAC data were not used in the study; nicotinamide dose and duration are unknown.
The label-free survey sample has no recorded treatment, so its treatment and factor value are 'not available'; its relation to the SILAC lysates is unknown.
'b' files are inferred to be re-injections (technical replicate 2) of the same fraction from the file names and a different 120 min method in the RAW headers; no document states this.
Fraction order is inferred from run names (ascending pH for pH-step runs; _01 to _04 for the NAM runs).
Trypsin/P rests on the deposited search settings and the 'strict trypsin specificity' statement; sdrf-tools reconcile flags cleavage_agent_unsupported.
Reduction and alkylation reagents, ancestry, passage number, culture medium and sample storage temperature are not available.
Organism part, cell type, disease, sex and age are HeLa cell-line facts from Cellosaurus, not study-specific statements.
